notes.title: DurDanto Demo : Patch Update Notes
notes.content:
Thank you for trying our demo. We've updated the demo with some changes that are listed below,

[list]
[*] Zubok's Sprites & Animations have been updated for better gaming experience.
[*] Minor UI changes.
[*] Enemies are balanced for better gaming experience.
[*] Minor bugs & glitches are fixed.
[/list]

We hope that you'll enjoy these changes. Thank you for your continuous support.
